races.name: Bath & West Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Sogna In Grande
runners_data.note: Lightly raced with only one previous run, making assessment difficult despite recent victory.

runners_data.name: Grand Vendetta
runners_data.note: Consistent performer who can track the pace and has proven form on similar ground conditions.

runners_data.name: Catwalk Girl
runners_data.note: Confirmed front-runner whose early speed could set up the race for closers if she goes too fast.

runners_data.name: Amatchmadeinheaven
runners_data.note: Natural leader with excellent record on good ground, winning twice from three similar going starts.

runners_data.name: Sure To Be Sure
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer who needs a strong pace to be effective, with mixed recent form.

races.paceDynamic: Amatchmadeinheaven and Catwalk Girl will dispute the early lead, creating an honest gallop throughout this small field. With Sure To Be Sure needing to be held up and Grand Vendetta likely tracking the leaders, the pace-setters face sustained pressure from the off with little respite.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Pace Battle
scenarios.trigger: If Amatchmadeinheaven and Catwalk Girl engage in a genuine speed duel from flag-fall
scenarios.body: The relentless gallop will suit the hold-up horses coming from behind. Sure To Be Sure and Grand Vendetta can capitalize on the leaders' exertions in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Amatchmadeinheaven can establish a clear lead without serious early pressure from Catwalk Girl
scenarios.body: The proven front-runner can dictate terms and maintain momentum to the line. His similar going record (2 wins from 3 runs) gives him the edge in these conditions.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Surge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace proves moderate with the front-runners going too slowly
scenarios.body: Grand Vendetta's prominent racing style allows her to track the pace and strike when the race develops. Her recent second at Sandown shows current form is solid.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Lightly Raced Improver
scenarios.trigger: If Sogna In Grande has improved significantly from his limited experience and can settle kindly
scenarios.body: The unproven runner could have untapped potential at just his second start. His recent win shows ability but the step up in class remains a question mark.

watchPoints.text: Amatchmadeinheaven and Catwalk Girl could burn each other out if they engage in a fierce early speed battle
Sure To Be Sure's recent question marks in form make him unreliable despite his hold-up style suiting the likely pace
Sogna In Grande's inexperience at this level could be exposed despite his lightly raced profile offering potential upside
Grand Vendetta needs the race to develop into a tactical affair to maximize her prominent racing style
The small field size means tactical positioning will be crucial with limited horses to provide cover

runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist with excellent good going win who should benefit from likely pace setup

runners_data.name: Jena d'Oudairies
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with solid good going record but needs to reverse recent soft ground disappointments

runners_data.name: Geezer Rockstar
runners_data.note: Versatile prominent runner whose good going form figures suggest competitive chance

runners_data.name: Matthias
runners_data.note: Likely uncontested leader whose front-running style could prove effective if allowed easy fractions

runners_data.name: Gold Link
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with decent good going placings but concerning strike rate on similar conditions

runners_data.name: Wispit Twob

races.paceDynamic: Matthias will likely lead unopposed with four prominent runners (Jukebox King, Twist Of Fatecatch, Jena d'Oudairies, Geezer Rockstar) tracking within striking distance but not applying early pressure. The sustainable gallop should set up perfectly for the three hold-up horses (Calme Olympien, Gold Link, Wispit Twob) to mount late challenges, creating a finish where stamina and tactical positioning prove decisive.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained gallop favors closers
scenarios.trigger: If Matthias sets uncontested fractions and the prominent quartet settle kindly
scenarios.body: The even pace allows hold-up horses to unleash finishing kicks. Calme Olympien and Gold Link time their runs perfectly to sweep past tiring leaders.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent battle develops early
scenarios.trigger: If Jukebox King, Twist Of Fatecatch and Geezer Rockstar press Matthias from the third mile
scenarios.body: The increased tempo stretches the field and favors horses with natural pace who can sustain their effort. Twist Of Fatecatch's consistent form and Geezer Rockstar's similar going record prove decisive.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Leader dominates throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Matthias finds his optimum rhythm and the prominent horses fail to close the gap sufficiently
scenarios.body: The front-runner capitalizes on the generous fractions and has enough left to repel late challenges. Jena d'Oudairies emerges best of the chasers with her good going form.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Extreme late surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly pedestrian and Wispit Twob gets the strongest finishing kick despite lowest rating
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses benefit from a crawling gallop that becomes a sprint finish. Wispit Twob's running style proves perfectly suited while Gold Link also benefits from the tactical setup.

watchPoints.text: Matthias building an unassailable lead if the prominent horses are too patient in the early stages
Twist Of Fatecatch and Geezer Rockstar potentially clashing for the same prominent position behind the leader
Calme Olympien needing a clear run in the home straight given his hold-up style in a small field
Gold Link's ability to produce his best effort given disappointing recent strike rate on good going
The pace development through the middle mile determining whether hold-up or prominent runners gain the advantage

races.name: Bridles New Luxury Care Home Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Golan Loop
runners_data.note: Strong recent form on good ground with two wins from last four starts makes him a major player.

runners_data.name: Broomfields Cave
runners_data.note: Excellent record on similar going conditions with seven wins from fifteen starts gives him solid claims.

runners_data.name: Muskoka
runners_data.note: Consistent prominent racer but lacks a recent win and may find this company too strong.

runners_data.name: Law Of Supply
runners_data.note: Lowest-rated runner but has won on good ground and could benefit from a tactical race.

runners_data.name: Loup De Maulde
runners_data.note: Only front runner in the field gives him a tactical advantage despite inconsistent recent form.

runners_data.name: Ignore The Door
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist with perfect record on good ground but small sample size creates uncertainty.

races.paceDynamic: Loup De Maulde is the only confirmed front runner and will dictate a measured gallop without pressure from the three prominent racers (Golan Loop, Muskoka, Law Of Supply) who are likely to settle just behind. The two hold-up horses (Broomfields Cave, Ignore The Door) will be positioned at the back, creating a sustainable tempo that should set up a tactical finish where the prominent racers can challenge early while the hold-up specialists need luck in running.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Loup De Maulde gets an easy lead and the prominent horses fail to apply pressure until too late.
scenarios.body: The race develops into a tactical crawl with the leader able to quicken clear approaching the last two fences. None of the chasers can match the finishing kick of a horse who has conserved energy throughout.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pressure Pays
scenarios.trigger: If Golan Loop and Muskoka press Loup De Maulde from halfway, creating genuine pace.
scenarios.body: The increased gallop stretches the field and exposes the stamina limitations of some runners over this extended trip. The prominent racers who forced the pace are best positioned to capitalize when the leader weakens.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Charge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses into a crawl and both hold-up horses get clear runs in the straight.
scenarios.body: Broomfields Cave and Ignore The Door benefit from their patient tactics as the race becomes a sprint finish. Their superior finishing speed tells over horses who have been racing prominently throughout.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Muddle Benefits Outsider
scenarios.trigger: If the race becomes stop-start with multiple horses making premature moves and burning themselves out.
scenarios.body: Law Of Supply, who has shown consistency at this level, profits from the tactical errors of others. The lower-rated runner finds himself in the perfect position to strike when the fancied horses have shot their bolt.

watchPoints.text: Loup De Maulde must be watched carefully early as the only leader - if he gets an uncontested lead the race could be over.
Broomfields Cave needs a clear run in the straight as hold-up horses often get trapped behind tired leaders in small fields.
Golan Loop's jumping must be monitored as any mistakes will compromise his prominent racing style over this trip.
The pace through the middle section will be crucial - too slow favors the hold-up horses, genuine pace suits the prominent racers.
Ignore The Door's small sample size on good ground makes his reliability questionable despite his perfect record.

races.paceDynamic: Harry Junior is the sole confirmed front runner and will dictate a sustainable gallop without early pressure from this field of hold-up performers. This creates a tactical race where the six closers (All Night Parking, Square Du Roule, It's A Breeze, Walkinthepresent, Lydeard Girl, Stage Show) must time their challenges perfectly over the final 3-4 furlongs.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Harry Junior maintains steady fractions and kicks clear turning in
scenarios.body: The lack of pace pressure allows Harry Junior to conserve energy and respond when challenged. His recent Soft ground win shows he can sustain his effort when getting an easy lead.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Strong Closer Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly crawling and suits the best staying finisher
scenarios.body: The tactical nature sets up perfectly for It's A Breeze or Walkinthepresent to unleash superior finishing kicks. It's A Breeze has the highest rating while Walkinthepresent won last time in similar conditions.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Mover Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the hold-up horses moves prominently before the home turn
scenarios.body: Square Du Roule or All Night Parking could profit by avoiding the inevitable traffic problems behind Harry Junior. Their positioning closer to the pace gives them first run on the leader when the race develops.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Package Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes a sprint finish
scenarios.body: Stage Show drops significantly in class and could benefit from his recent course win if the race becomes messy. Lydeard Girl has been consistent without winning but could find improvement.

watchPoints.text: Harry Junior must be monitored early - if he goes too fast trying to build a lead, he becomes very vulnerable
Traffic problems are likely in the straight with six hold-up horses converging behind the lone leader
Walkinthepresent and It's A Breeze positioning turning in will be crucial given their finishing ability
The pace in the middle section - if it becomes crawling, it dramatically favors the strongest finishers
Stage Show's jumping and confidence levels after dropping in class from recent disappointing efforts

races.paceDynamic: Rangatira Jack will establish the early lead without pressure, with Hatos and My Rockstar providing company from prominent positions. The lack of other genuine pace horses means Rangatira Jack can dictate a steady tempo, creating a tactical race where the five hold-up horses (Kingcormac, Move With The Beat, Universal Secret, and Applicationofcash) must time their challenges perfectly from off the pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Rangatira Jack maintains an even gallop without serious early pressure
scenarios.body: Rangatira Jack controls the tempo throughout and has enough left to resist late challenges. The hold-up horses struggle to make up sufficient ground against the solid pace-setter.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes pedestrian allowing closers to unleash devastating finishes
scenarios.body: Move With The Beat and Kingcormac benefit from the slow tempo to produce powerful late runs. The front-runners pay for the lack of genuine pace pressure earlier.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If Hatos or My Rockstar can sit close enough to strike at the right moment
scenarios.body: Hatos uses his prominent style to stay within range before challenging Rangatira Jack approaching the final fence. The hold-up horses are caught too far back to respond effectively.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Rangatira Jack stops suddenly or makes jumping errors under pressure
scenarios.body: Universal Secret and Applicationofcash benefit from a complete pace collapse to surge through late. The race becomes a sprint finish where stamina reserves prove decisive.

watchPoints.text: Rangatira Jack getting an uncontested lead could prove decisive if he maintains jumping fluency.
Move With The Beat needs a strongly-run race to unleash his class advantage from the rear.
Hatos must position perfectly behind Rangatira Jack to have any chance of timing his challenge.
Universal Secret requires pace collapse or jumping errors ahead to get competitive.
Kingcormac's hold-up style needs others to ensure genuine pace throughout the contest.

races.paceDynamic: Victory Shout is the sole natural front runner in this field and should get an uncontested lead, able to dictate a sustainable gallop without early pressure. With most runners adopting hold-up tactics (Get In Order, Bread And Butter, Walk In The West, Forest Hills, Prince Rhinegold, Sawpit Sienna, Eric Gorcombe, Mancero), the pace will likely be steady early before quickening from the home turn as the prominent runners (Lake Tiberias, Prairie Diamond, Athena's Dream) try to bridge to Victory Shout.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Victory Shout Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Victory Shout maintains a steady gallop and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: The leader's class advantage tells as he stretches the field on the run-in. The hold-up horses struggle to make up the ground in time with too much to do.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Brigade Swarms Late
scenarios.trigger: If Victory Shout sets too slow a pace early and gets swamped in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The patient tactics pay off as the closers find their rhythm late. Get In Order and Bread And Butter benefit from their proven stamina at this trip.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Bridge Gap
scenarios.trigger: If Lake Tiberias and Prairie Diamond track Victory Shout closely and challenge early
scenarios.body: The prominent runners use their tactical speed to get first run on the leader. Prairie Diamond's course experience proves decisive in a driving finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Victory Shout goes too slowly and gets challenged from halfway by the prominent runners
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from three furlongs out with stamina less important. Forest Hills and Prince Rhinegold benefit from the lack of early pace.

watchPoints.text: Victory Shout sets too steady a pace early and gets swamped by the large contingent of hold-up horses in the final furlong
Walk In The West and Eric Gorcombe both show warning signs of fading in the finish which could prove costly
Prairie Diamond and Lake Tiberias positioning behind Victory Shout will determine if the prominent runners can bridge the gap
Get In Order and Bread And Butter need the pace to develop properly to give their stamina advantage full effect
Athena's Dream stepping back up in trip after heavy ground failure raises questions about her current form
